GroupChatScreen.tsx (704 lines) — group chat with send permissions, typing, reactions, reply, members, media

CreateGroupChatScreen.tsx — two-stage group creation with member search, photo/cover upload

ChatTopBar — avatar, title, subtitle, search, info, presence dot

backend_support.typing_indicator: YES — sends userId in payload, but frontend hook discards it (returns boolean only)
backend_support.pinned_messages: NO — no backend endpoint for pinning messages
backend_support.polls: NO — no backend endpoint for polls in chat
backend_support.mentions: NO — no @mention parsing or notification in chat (exists only in creator stickers)
backend_support.unread_separator: NO — no unread separator in message list
backend_support.group_description: YES — stored in conversation.description, shown in info screen but NOT in chat

gaps.title: Group chat shows generic 'Someone is typing…' instead of named typing indicator
gaps.evidence: GroupChatScreen.tsx line 524: '<Caption color={colors.textMuted}>Someone is typing…</Caption>'. useTypingIndicator (realtimeClient.ts line 259) returns only boolean, discarding payload.userId that the backend already sends.
gaps.competitor_evidence: WhatsApp 2026 beta: shows 'Ali is typing…' / '2 people are typing…' / '3 people are typing…' (brandligo.com, WABetaInfo). Telegram: shows sender name with typing indicator. iMessage: shows 'X is typing…' with animated dots.
gaps.impact: Prototype-grade tell. Users can't tell who is typing in a group. Reads as AI-made. WhatsApp/Telegram/iMessage all show names.
gaps.fix: Upgrade useTypingIndicator to expose typing user IDs. Resolve to display names from participant profiles. Render 'Alice is typing…' / 'Alice and Bob are typing…' / '3 people are typing…' with animated dots.
gaps.validation: Visual: header subtitle shows named typing with animated dots. Multiple typists show count. Auto-clears after 4s.

gaps.title: No swipe-to-reply gesture on message bubbles
gaps.evidence: No swipe/GestureHandler found in chat components. Reply is only via long-press → context menu → reply. MessageBubble has onLongPress but no swipe gesture.
gaps.competitor_evidence: WhatsApp/iMessage: swipe right on message to reply. Telegram: swipe left on message to reply. Google Messages 2026: swipe right to reply, swipe left for timestamps. ethora.com: 'Swipe right on mobile (the WhatsApp/iMessage convention)' — don't invent new gestures.
gaps.impact: Missing the most-used reply interaction in messaging. Long-press-only reply feels prototype-grade. Every flagship messaging app has swipe-to-reply.
gaps.fix: Add swipe-right-to-reply gesture on message rows using react-native-gesture-handler. Show reply preview in composer on release. Haptic on trigger threshold.
gaps.validation: Swipe right on any message triggers reply. Haptic feedback at threshold. Reply preview appears in composer. Cancels if swipe doesn't cross threshold.

gaps.title: Group chat typing indicator uses plain text, not animated dots
gaps.evidence: GroupChatScreen line 522-526: renders '<Caption>Someone is typing…</Caption>' — plain text, no animated dots. TypingIndicator component with animated dots EXISTS (TypingIndicator.tsx) but is not used in GroupChatScreen. InboxConversationRow has its own TypingDots component.
gaps.competitor_evidence: WhatsApp/Telegram/iMessage all use animated dots for typing. Plain text 'typing…' reads as prototype-grade.
gaps.impact: Inconsistent with inbox row (which has animated dots). Reads as unfinished. WhatsApp/Telegram use animated dots universally.
gaps.fix: Use TypingIndicator animated dots alongside named typing text in group header subtitle and in-chat typing row.
gaps.validation: Animated dots visible when someone is typing. Consistent with inbox row typing indicator.

gaps.title: No unread message separator in message list
gaps.evidence: No unread separator found in ChatScreen or GroupChatScreen. No 'unreadSeparator' or 'UNREAD_SEPARATOR' in codebase.
gaps.competitor_evidence: WhatsApp: 'X unread messages' separator when scrolling to unread. Telegram: unread separator line. iMessage: unread separator.
gaps.impact: Users can't see where unread messages begin when returning to a conversation. Standard messaging feature missing.
gaps.fix: Add unread separator pill ('X unread messages') at the first unread message index, computed from conversation.unread count and message list.
gaps.validation: Separator appears at first unread message. Shows count. Disappears after messages are read.

gaps.title: Group description not shown as pinned bar in chat
gaps.evidence: GroupChatInfoScreen shows description in hero section, but GroupChatScreen does not show it. conversation.description is available but unused in the chat view.
gaps.competitor_evidence: WhatsApp: shows group description as a system message at the top of new groups. Telegram: shows group description in a pinned info bar.
gaps.impact: Group purpose/context is hidden in info screen. New members don't see the group description in the chat itself.
gaps.fix: Show a dismissible group description bar at the top of the message list when description exists and hasn't been dismissed.
gaps.validation: Description bar appears at top of group chat. Dismissible. Does not reappear after dismissal for the same group.

gaps.title: No message forwarding
gaps.evidence: MessageContextMenu actions: copy, reply, react, delete, report. No 'forward' action. deriveMessageActions in messageContextMenuCapabilities has no forward.
gaps.competitor_evidence: WhatsApp/Telegram/iMessage all have forward in context menu. Standard messaging action.
gaps.impact: Users can't share a message to another conversation. Missing standard messaging action.
gaps.fix: Add 'forward' action to context menu. Open conversation picker. Send message content to selected conversation.
gaps.validation: Forward action in context menu. Opens conversation picker. Message content sent to selected conversation.

gaps.title: No @mentions or @all in group chat
gaps.evidence: No mention parsing, mention suggestions, or @all feature in chat. Backend has no mention endpoint for chat.
gaps.competitor_evidence: WhatsApp 2026: @all mentions for admins in groups >32, @name mentions with notifications. Telegram: @username mentions with @ badge navigation.
gaps.impact: Can't address specific members in busy groups. Can't notify all members. Major group chat feature missing.
gaps.fix: Backend: add mention metadata to messages. Frontend: parse @mentions, show suggestion picker, render mentions with color, send notifications.
gaps.validation: Typing @ shows member suggestions. Mentioned user gets notification. @all available for admins.

gaps.title: No polls in group chat
gaps.evidence: No poll feature in chat. Backend has no poll endpoint.
gaps.competitor_evidence: WhatsApp 2026: polls with end time, hidden voter names, edit within 15min. Telegram: polls with media, statistics, time limits, quiz mode.
gaps.impact: Can't make group decisions. Major group chat feature missing for coordination (group buys, co-own decisions).
gaps.fix: Backend: add poll creation/voting endpoints. Frontend: poll composer, poll message bubble, vote UI, results display.
gaps.validation: Can create poll in group. Members can vote. Results show in real-time. Poll closes at end time.
